g.text: BARE-METAL MULTI-SENSOR DATA LOGGER · SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
on microSD · new file per session
Sensors are decimated, timestamped from the
RTC, formatted as fixed-point rows, and written
through FatFs to a new CSV file each session.
